local_revision.scope: User-requested upload of the local operations example, reading controls and source-path binding

design_source.label: User-approved deployment and memory compatibility report
design_source.transfer: Reading order, warm palette, layered comparison, responsibility boundaries and separate acceptance evidence
design_source.not_transferred: Private prompts, machine paths, product facts, identities, timestamps or access links

local_revision.reading_controls: Approved light default; explicit persisted theme choice; copy only on click with an honest manual fallback
local_revision.source_path: Bind the final absolute filesystem path; hosted preview URLs never replace it

screenshot_evidence_revision.scope: Business-decision screenshot evidence and persisted per-item capture gaps; documentation only
screenshot_evidence_revision.contract: Provide actual supporting screenshots with source and limits; preserve textual evidence when screenshots are missing
screenshot_evidence_revision.follow_up: Read saved item records before related exploration or retest, remind to capture missing screenshots, and close gaps only after collection and verification

theme_choice_revision.scope: Add explicit system/light/dark preference; preserve approved light default and existing light/dark persistence
theme_choice_revision.verification: Mocked DOM tests are logic evidence, not device-specific visual acceptance

table_layout_revision.scope: Remove universal first-column compression; add opt-in semantic long-table layout and native range column sizing
table_layout_revision.boundaries: Single header, 2–8 unspanned columns, explicit colgroup; no saved widths; print and no-JavaScript reading stay available
table_layout_revision.verification: Mocked DOM and integration tests are not browser, touchscreen or screen-reader acceptance
